baseline_models.focus_anchor: The celestial plural ٱلنُّجُومُ is predicated by ٱنكَدَرَتْ, whose focus inventory opposes clouded color to clarity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Individually visible celestial lights lose contrast and purity as a field. The event can therefore be a corruption of visibility before, or alongside, any change of location.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the ordinary celestial bodies whose visibility is altered.
Supplies turbidity, dull color, and the loss of a clear medium as the predicate's operative change.

changed_reading.after: The star field becomes optically turbid or color-dulled; extinction is possible but is not required by this branch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same subject-predicate pair can join celestial bodies to the in-k-d-r image of rushing, scattering, and plunging.
baseline_models.mechanism: A formerly distributed but ordered array breaks station and descends in successive scattered motion. Loss of arrangement, speed, and downward trajectory matter more here than dimness.

activation_trace.role: Fixes the moving plurality as celestial bodies rather than an abstract darkness.
Contributes fast, scattered plunging in bands and turns the predicate into a kinematic collapse.

changed_reading.before: The stars lose their light while remaining where they are.
changed_reading.after: The stars lose formation and rush or plunge as a dispersed celestial multitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ن ج م can name both an object read in the sky and a projecting marker, while ك د ر can make that marker unclear and can activate sustained looking.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah stages an epistemic failure as well as a physical one: the sky's conspicuous guides become unreliable precisely while holding the observer's gaze. Planning by remote signs is interrupted.

activation_trace.role: Contributes the practice of looking into stars and thinking through a plan, making the stars readable signs.
Contributes a conspicuous projecting marker or clear road, giving the star field an orienting function.
Makes the orienting field turbid and therefore no longer cleanly legible.
Adds the fixed gaze that remains trained on the failing sign, without claiming that this remote branch controls the verb's grammar.

changed_reading.before: A remote astronomical spectacle is described.
changed_reading.after: A readable and orienting sky becomes illegible, leaving the viewer staring at signs that no longer yield a stable plan.

context_deltas.mechanism: The neighboring conditions repeatedly reverse ordinary binding states: the central luminary is folded into a mass, the distributed stars scatter, prized dependents are left vacant, the wild are driven together, and selves are paired. Focus 81:2 becomes one controlled de-aggregation within a larger re-sorting operation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the naturally distributed celestial plurality whose ordering can be reversed.
Supplies dispersal and plunging, the de-aggregation pole of the sequence.
Supplies wrapping and compacting parts together, the immediate opposite state to stellar dispersal.
Supplies vacancy and disabling, showing an expected attachment or use relation being suspended.
Supplies the driving and collecting of a plurality toward one destination.
Supplies the joining of one thing to a counterpart, another deliberate reconfiguration of relation.

structural_cues: 81:1-7 repeat the same conditional frame and predominantly passive feminine-plural predicates.
The sequence alternates compacting, scattering, vacating, gathering, filling, and pairing rather than moving monotonically toward mere disorder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct operations on plural subjects; I place them on a common aggregation axis and infer a coordinated re-sorting. A live alternative is that the operations are independent catastrophe images with no shared state machine.

changed_reading.before: The stars undergo one isolated instance of celestial chaos.
changed_reading.after: The stars are deliberately de-aggregated as one term in a wider reversal and reclassification of how beings and materials are bound together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The projecting lights above and the elevated solids below both cease to provide fixed bearings. Stars scatter or plunge while mountains are displaced, unfastening the vertical and terrestrial coordinate frame together.

activation_trace.role: Makes the stars conspicuous markers and a clear route rather than only lights.
Removes the celestial markers from station through scattered plunging.
Supplies the elevated, solid terrestrial landmark whose fixity normally anchors orientation.
Supplies removal and displacement, making the lower landmark fail in parallel with the upper one.

structural_cues: 81:2 and 81:3 are adjacent clauses with identical وإذا + definite plural subject + passive predicate architecture.
Their subjects occupy opposite poles of the ordinary visual field: stars above and mountains on the horizon or ground.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a projecting celestial marker, solid elevation, stellar plunging, and mountain displacement; I infer that these jointly dismantle a coordinate system. They could instead be two unrelated scale demonstrations.

changed_reading.before: Only the sky changes while earthly orientation remains available.
changed_reading.after: Both upper and lower landmarks lose station, so 81:2 participates in the collapse of the observer's entire frame of reference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pouring and scattered-plunge branches of ك د ر can turn points of light into descending material, while the seas soon become filled and ignited. This permits a cross-domain model in which upper matter spills toward lower reservoirs and changes their state.

activation_trace.role: Treats each star as something that had risen into view, setting up a reversal of emergence.
Contributes pouring as a material analogy for the stars' change, despite the branch's transitive distance from the focus form.
Adds downward rushing and scattering so the proposed transfer has a trajectory.
Supplies the vast lower body of water as a possible receiving reservoir.
Supplies filling, allowing the sea clause to register an influx rather than only ignition.
Supplies kindling, allowing descending luminous matter to be imagined as changing the reservoir into fire.

structural_cues: 81:2 and 81:6 belong to the same uninterrupted chain of passive cosmic transformations.
The packet does not state a destination for the stars or a source for the sea's filling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pouring/plunging stars and a filled or kindled sea; I supply the downward transfer arrow between them. The materially live alternative is simultaneous but causally independent transformations.

changed_reading.before: Stars fall as inert points, and the sea changes separately.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the stars behave like a luminous particulate spill whose descent helps recast the lower waters as filled or ignited matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: As remote celestial markers become turbid, the later sequence makes concealed moral evidence progressively immediate: a question is posed, written sheets are exposed, the covering sky is removed, and each self knows what it has made present. Visibility is not simply extinguished; it migrates from cosmic signs to accountable particulars.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the conspicuous marker whose public legibility is lost.
Supplies the opacity side of the proposed exchange.
Supplies direct questioning, converting a hidden wrong into an explicit demand for account.
Supplies written records as a different, durable sign system.
Supplies opening, spreading, and branching out, making the records inspectable.
Supplies removal of a cover and exposure of what had been screened.
Supplies disclosure to a knower, completing the movement from opacity to recognition.
Supplies nearness and witnessed presence, replacing remote inference with immediate evidence.

structural_cues: The branchless root و ء د at 81:8 is used only as the packet's structural cue for a concealed victim placed into the questioning sequence; no branch ID is inferred for it.
81:8-14 move from passive question and killing through opened records and stripped cover to the active knowing of an individual self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic clouding followed by questioning, opened records, uncovered sky, knowledge, and presence; I infer a compensating transfer from remote sign-reading to immediate disclosure. A live alternative is simple temporal succession without exchange.

changed_reading.before: Stellar clouding means that reality becomes uniformly less visible.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic visibility fails while accountable reality becomes more exposed: the loss of distant signs is paired with the forced presence of records, acts, and victims.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stars' light is dulled, yet fire is intensified; remote celestial points lose stable presence, yet a concealed garden is driven near. The sequence can be read as redistribution of luminosity and distance rather than simple deletion of both.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the remote celestial lights from which brightness and distance are being removed.
Supplies the dulling of the upper lights.
Supplies newly intensified flame, relocating rather than eliminating fierce luminosity.
Supplies an active rush into proximity, countering the remoteness associated with celestial points.

structural_cues: 81:12-13 are paired passive conditions immediately before the apodosis at 81:14.
The pair juxtaposes intensification with approach after the earlier cosmic losses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dimmed stars, kindled fire, and something brought near; I infer that brightness and felt proximity are reassigned toward sites of consequence. They may instead be independent contrasts with no conserved qualities.

changed_reading.before: The universe only loses light and accessible order.
changed_reading.after: Upper light and remoteness are withdrawn while fierce light and consequence are brought close, making stellar dimming part of a redistribution of perceptual force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later oath supplies celestial hiding and return, continuous motion, entry into shelters, thinning boundary-darkness, and dawn opening. These cues preserve a live reading in which 81:2 changes the stars' regime of motion and visibility rather than asserting only terminal annihilation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the celestial population whose later behavior can revise the initial event.
Supplies rapid scattering and plunging as a transition into mobile behavior.
Supplies celestial bodies that withdraw from sight and return, weakening an exclusively terminal reading.
Supplies flowing motion, recasting the sky as a dynamic field.
Supplies celestial disappearance into hiding places, a structured retreat rather than mere extinction.
Supplies thin darkness at either edge of night, placing visibility loss at a reversible boundary.
Supplies the opening of morning, providing a counter-motion from constriction into renewed visibility.

structural_cues: 81:15-18 form a second compact celestial and diurnal tableau after the first conditional series.
The later tableau uses active motion and boundary images rather than the earlier passive transformations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies later celestial hiding, running, and reappearance-adjacent boundary imagery; I let that tableau resonate backward with the stars of 81:2 without asserting identical referents. The alternative is that the oath's objects are distinct and do not revise 81:2.

changed_reading.before: Inkadarat can only mean that every star is finally extinguished.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading sees the stars break formation and enter a mobile regime of plunging, withdrawal, concealment, and possible renewed appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once the remote star field becomes unreadable, the latter section supplies another chain for knowledge: articulated speech, a messenger, trust, direct seeing at the horizon, manifest disclosure, and responsible handling of what is hidden. The focus ayah can mark the failure of impersonal celestial inference before authenticated communication is foregrounded.

activation_trace.role: Supplies star-reading and deliberation as the older or failing route to knowledge.
Supplies a visible guiding mark whose authority depends on clarity.
Disrupts that impersonal sign channel through clouding.
Supplies explicit articulated speech as a transmissible alternative to reading remote objects.
Supplies an accountable messenger and message channel.
Supplies settled trust as the reliability property of that channel.
Supplies ocular and insightful seeing, grounding the communication claim in witnessed perception.
Supplies the distant horizon as the precise visual boundary where seeing is asserted.
Supplies disclosure of meaning by speech or sign, directly countering the clouded sign field.
Supplies what is screened from eyes, defining the information that cannot be secured by ordinary celestial seeing alone.

structural_cues: At 81:19 the surah changes from conditional cosmic scenes to declarative claims about a saying and its transmission.
81:23 places an act of seeing at a clear horizon, echoing but transforming the earlier visual sky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed stellar clarity and then a trusted, seen, manifest communication chain; I infer a transfer of epistemic authority from remote celestial signs to message and witness. The two sections could instead be juxtaposed without one replacing the other.

changed_reading.before: The star event has no bearing on how knowledge is obtained.
changed_reading.after: The clouding of readable stars clears space for a different authority: articulated, entrusted, witnessed disclosure concerning what ordinary sight cannot reach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The conspicuous celestial road fails, after which the listener is challenged about a route, given a reminder, and offered straightness. The loss of an external compass becomes a demand for chosen orientation rather than permission for directionlessness.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a visible marker and clear road, giving the stars a navigational affordance.
Makes that external guide cloudy and unreliable.
Supplies route, destination, and adopted way, turning motion into a question of orientation.
Supplies a reminder that can function as a non-celestial orienting marker.
Supplies straightness, balance, and an upright course as the demanded orientation.

structural_cues: The direct question at 81:26 is followed immediately by reminder and straightening language.
This closing address converts the observer of the opening spectacle into a responsible traveler.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed sky-marker, route language, reminder, and straightness; I infer a transfer from external navigation to ethical or volitional orientation. The path vocabulary may be rhetorical without depending on the stars as a compass.

changed_reading.before: When the stars fail, orientation simply ends.
changed_reading.after: The collapse of external bearings exposes the sharper question of one's own route and the possibility of becoming straight without a stable celestial compass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing nested wills and lordship frame the stars' apparent loss of control inside a larger agency that owns, repairs, and completes worlds. The visible formation dissolves, but the event need not be ontologically ungoverned.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the surface appearance of uncontrolled rushing, scattering, and plunge.
Supplies layered willing directed toward an object or event, enclosing local agency in a larger one.
Supplies the worshiped divine agent named at the outer level of will.
Supplies ownership and sovereignty over the worlds whose visible order is changing.
Supplies repair, formation, and completion, allowing scattering to be a phase of reconfiguration rather than purposeless breakdown.

structural_cues: 81:29 closes the surah by nesting human willing inside divine willing.
The title of lordship applies to the same plural worlds whose opening visual order is dismantled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies apparent stellar disorder, nested willing, sovereignty, and completion; I infer governance of the deconfiguration. It remains possible that the closing will statement addresses only human straightening and should not be projected back onto stellar mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The plunging stars signify sheer cosmic loss of control.
changed_reading.after: Their formation visibly fails while the surah's closing frame keeps that failure inside purposive, world-level governance and possible re-formation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus plural strongly invites celestial stars, yet the focus inventory also anchors ن ج م in stemless shoots and ك د ر in clods thrown up from worked ground. Preserve it only as a terrestrial image-echo or double exposure, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both focus roots possess a coherent ground register: small shoots emerge without stems, while soil clods are raised and scattered.

activation_trace.role: Supplies small stemless vegetation emerging at ground level.
Supplies earth clods thrown up by force, giving the ground image violent churn.

changed_reading.before: Only distant heavenly points are disturbed.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image-echo, the line also flashes a ground surface where delicate emergences and compacted clods are torn into the same upheaval.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates the non-dominant وسم mapping carried under the context root س م و, then combines it with skinning language. It remains anchored in the focus star-as-marker branch and the packet's exact split mapping, but downstream prose should mark it as a material metaphor rather than lexical identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus stars can function as projecting visual markers; context 81:11 supplies both a sign-bearing mapping for sky and removal of a skin-like cover.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the stars as projecting marks on a readable visual field.
Supplies the marks' scattered removal from their prior arrangement.
Through the packet's split mapping, supplies a visible mark by which a thing is recognized, making the sky imaginable as a marked surface.
Supplies skinning or peeling, turning removal of the sky into removal of the substrate that bore the marks.

changed_reading.before: Stars fall inside an otherwise neutral container called sky.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the stars are marks shaken from a sign-bearing sky-skin just before that marked surface itself is peeled away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprise comes from using the packet's non-dominant س ل ل mapping for the context spelling س ء ل. The resulting extraction mechanism remains anchored by focus opacity and the later opening and uncovering sequence, but it must be labeled a split-root activation, not presented as the ordinary sense of the question verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes public sky-signs turbid; the context then supplies a split-root image of secret drawing-out followed by spreading and uncovering.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the formerly visible marker against which concealed evidence is contrasted.
Supplies obscuration, the condition from which the extraction sequence moves.
Through the packet's secondary mapping, supplies a gentle or secret drawing-out that can image elicited evidence.
Supplies unfolding and spreading once the concealed material has been elicited.
Supplies final uncovering, completing the exploratory extraction pathway.

changed_reading.before: The clouding stars only remove evidence and make the world unreadable.
changed_reading.after: In a contained split-root reading, cosmic opacity triggers the opposite process below: concealed testimony is drawn out, unfolded, and uncovered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 81:25 denies a rejected adversarial source for the saying and never states that the stars strike anything. The plunging branch in the focus and the later expulsion and stone imagery make a ballistic exclusion model possible, but prose must retain the missing causal link and avoid converting resonance into narrated fact.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus predicate explicitly supports rushing and plunging celestial bodies; the later rejection vocabulary supplies distance, expulsion, and stone-like casting.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the celestial objects available for a projectile-like image.
Supplies rapid plunging and scattered bands, giving the image ballistic motion.
Supplies distance and severance, defining an excluded outside position.
Supplies cursing, expulsion, and driving away as the possible function assigned to the plunge.
Supplies gathered stones, making the cross-domain projectile resemblance visible.

changed_reading.before: The stars are passive debris in a collapse.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their plunge can resemble an active exclusion force that marks and drives away a severed false source, though the text does not state that causal action.

strongest_changes: The focus branches preserve both optical turbidity and rapid scattered plunging; neither should be collapsed into the other.
The opening sequence recasts stellar dispersal as one controlled aggregation-state reversal among wrapping, vacating, gathering, filling, and pairing.
Clouded celestial signs are answered by opened records, stripped cover, present knowledge, and later authenticated speech, producing an epistemic transfer rather than uniform darkness.
The later hiding-running celestial tableau keeps a nonterminal motion-and-visibility reading alive beside catastrophic collapse.
The failed external sky-road returns as the closing demand to choose a route and become straight.
summary.what_was_special: 81:2 is unusually multistable: one rare predicate supports color-clouding, pouring, sustained gaze, and scattered plunge, while ن ج م supports stars, emergent things, readable signs, and projecting markers. The surrounding ayat repeatedly reverse visibility, aggregation, location, and authority, allowing physical, epistemic, navigational, and material readings to coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus grammar does not decide whether loss of clarity, fall, scattering, or several at once dominates ٱنكَدَرَتْ.
The later retreating celestial objects may revise the same star field or may be a separate oath image.
The sky-to-sea transfer is abductive because the packet supplies transformations but no explicit causal destination arrow.
The marked-sky and concealed-extraction outliers depend on legitimate but non-dominant split mappings and require explicit qualification.
The closing governance frame may apply backward to cosmic deconfiguration, or more narrowly to human willing and straightening.
